name: Drowned Choir
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
abilities.description: The drowned choir can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
abilities.description: While in sunlight, the drowned choir has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The drowned choir makes two Drowning Touch attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Wailing Radiance.

actions.name: Drowning Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (6d8 + 3) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Wailing Radiance
actions.description: Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the drowned choir's next turn.

condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

unplaced.text: The drowned choir sings in one voice.

generation.userConcept: a drowned cathedral choir that sings in one voice
generation.cite: composition after Wraith (CR 5) — Life Drain under the sunlight bane
